message:
Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/listen/dns/proto_dns.c","function":"mod_decode","line":164,"var":"data","code":"if (!fr_dns_packet_ok(buffer, packet_len, true)) return 0;","note":"The UDP listener accepts only packets that look like DNS queries and forwards the raw attacker-controlled packet bytes into the DNS decoder."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/listen/dns/proto_dns.c","function":"mod_decode","line":201,"var":"packet_ctx.lb","code":"packet_ctx.lb = fr_dns_labels_init(packet_ctx.tmp_ctx, packet_ctx.packet, 256);","note":"The decoder initializes DNS label tracking on the same attacker-controlled packet buffer before parsing names."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/protocols/dns/decode.c","function":"fr_dns_decode","line":448,"var":"packet_len","code":"if (packet_len < DNS_HDR_LEN) return 0;","note":"The packet must be at least a DNS header, so the remaining bytes are treated as DNS payload for record decoding."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/protocols/dns/decode.c","function":"fr_dns_decode","line":470,"var":"p","code":"slen = decode_record(ctx, cursor, attr_dns_question, p, end - p, packet_ctx, packet + 4);","note":"The question section is decoded from the attacker-controlled payload, using the QDCOUNT field as the loop bound."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/protocols/dns/decode.c","function":"decode_record","line":418,"var":"count","code":"count = fr_net_to_uint16(counter);","note":"The number of questions comes directly from the packet header and controls how many records are parsed."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/protocols/dns/decode.c","function":"decode_record","line":426,"var":"p","code":"slen = fr_struct_from_network(ctx, cursor, attr, p, end - p, true, packet_ctx, decode_value_trampoline, NULL);","note":"Each question record is structurally decoded from the remaining attacker-controlled bytes."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/protocols/dns/decode.c","function":"decode_value_trampoline","line":106,"var":"parent->type","code":"if ((parent->type == FR_TYPE_STRING) && !parent->flags.extra && parent->flags.subtype) return decode_dns_labels(...);","note":"DNS name fields are routed to the label decoder, so the question name bytes are interpreted as compressed DNS labels."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/protocols/dns/decode.c","function":"decode_dns_labels","line":354,"var":"next","code":"slen = fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length(packet_ctx->packet, data, data + data_len - packet_ctx->packet, &next, packet_ctx->lb);","note":"The decoder computes the uncompressed DNS name length from the attacker-controlled label sequence."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/lib/util/dns.c","function":"fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length","line":881,"var":"label pointer","code":"The label walker follows compression pointers and advances through the packet until it finds the end of the name.","note":"A malformed compression chain can make the walker read past the intended name boundary while chasing label bytes."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/lib/util/dns.c","function":"fr_dns_label_to_value_box","line":1206,"var":"after","code":"slen = fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length(packet, src, len, &after, lb);","note":"The same uncompressed-length logic is reused when converting the DNS name into a value box for the request pair."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src/lib/util/dns.c","function":"fr_dns_label_to_value_box","line":1249,"var":"dst","code":"The decoded label bytes are copied into the destination value box based on the computed length.","note":"If the computed length is too large or inconsistent with the actual packet, the copy reads one byte past the allocated packet buffer, triggering the heap-buffer-overflow READ."}
]
p.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
PY
